What are you doing?

why did I go so hard?

messages.ko: 저런 멘트들 한지도 기억이 안나네 ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: I don't even remember saying lines like that ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
Seeing how much screen time I got in Episode 1,
I guess I died later on.
Even before Badge War came out,
whenever I saw things on fansigns or Kakaotalk,
"Hayeon is going to win!!!??? She seems like she'll do really well this time~~"
or things like that,
"She won't die on the first day, right~"
every time I saw comments like these,
my heart hurt so much.

messages.ko: 채원이가 너 진짜 화났다고 하더라 ㅋㅋ 나중에는 아예 채원이도 안 봤다며
messages.en: Chaewon said you were really angry ㅋㅋ and apparently later you didn't even look at Chaewon.
No ㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
Kim Chaewon voted to kill me,
and as soon as the cameras turned off,
she said, "I knew it wasn't you ㅋ"
she said that.
Ugh.
But although it was edited out,
when we were trying to make someone else suspicious and sway public opinion,
Kim Chaewon kept bringing it back to me.
So I was like, "Then why did you do that when you knew!!!!!!"
When I said that,
she was like, "It's fun~"????
So I glared at Kim Chaewon all day.
Whenever I'd stand far away and glare at her,
she'd smile so brightly and run away,
you were cute, Chaewon.
After getting treated like this myself,
I realized why the members in Badge War 3
resented me so much ㅎㅎ

messages.ko: 내가 배신했던 사람들이 날 죽였어 ㅋㄹㅋㅅㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
messages.en: The people I betrayed ended up killing me ㅋㄹㅋㅅㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Has my karma been paid off now?

messages.ko: 유연언니가 너 활어회라고 한 게 너무 웃김
messages.en: It's so funny that Yooyeon unnie called you a live fish sashimi.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
I got so annoyed by that that every time I saw Yooyeon unnie,
I'd go, "Live fish sashimi~~??? Live fish sashimi~~~?"
But even if we filmed Badge War again,
I think I would've died in Episode 1 anyway.
I just can't stop myself from being too much.

messages.ko: 근데 하연이 그 안경 쓰니까 진짜 너무 멋있더라…

I looked really handsome that day,
though it's a shame about the lighting~

messages.en: Arguing with Soomin lately has become my hobby..
Even when Soomin doesn't really say much,
I'll go, "That's not it, though? I think you got it wrong~?? Can you say that again~~?"
and then she starts rambling all by herself.
But while we were filming,
everyone even cut down on their sleep
to figure things out,
and it was intense.
It was so much fun.
Hayeon needs to have lots of screen time in the next episode too…..

I worked really hard on my reactions.
"Wow! Oh my! This?? Wow, this is crazy!!"
I think stuff like that will come out.

Who knows who it'll be~~?
You never know~
Anyway,
To commemorate Badge War,
Agent Hayeon
The most innocent Hayeon right now.

messages.ko: 라잌하연을 왜 더 이쁜상태에서 춘것이 아니였을까
messages.en: why didn't I perform Like Hayeon when I looked prettier?
It's my lifelong regret.
We went on tour after that came out,
and people kept dancing Like Hayeon with Like Hayeon slogans,
If I'd known people would love it this much,
I would've tried to look a little prettier…
Wearing a flower vest, an embarrassing pajama outfit, and sunglasses…
I still can't properly watch it..
As long as it was funny, that's enough ㅋ
I've already let it go, though.
And soon,
on SNS,
I'll upload some photos.
